params.caption: 🖥️ OLED monitor shipments doubled in Q3 2026 Global OLED monitor shipments doubled year over year in the third quarter, according to a TrendForce report. Gamers are driving the growth as OLED gets cheaper and display upgrades look more attractive while AI demand squeezes other PC components. ASUS leads the market. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 17:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👍 Like if you game on OLED · 💬 Is your next monitor OLED? #OLED #GamingMonitor #ASUS #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
